refsect1.title: Description
refsect1.para: &mkvextract-gui; extracts tracks, timestamps, chapters, attachments and tags from &matroska; files with &mkvextract;, laid out like gMKVExtractGUI. Files and folders given on the command line, added or dropped onto the window are read with &mkvmerge;'s identification; folders are searched for &matroska; files. Each file lists its tracks, chapters, attachments and tags; the checked ones are extracted, either at once (Extract) or later from the job queue (Add Jobs, Jobs...). Every file is extracted in one pass of &mkvextract;.

The output files go next to their source file or into a chosen folder. Their names come from patterns (Options...) with placeholders such as {FilenameNoExt}, {TrackID:00}, {Language}, {Codec} and {EffectiveDelay}, an audio track's first timestamp minus the video's in milliseconds. The extension follows the codec. Existing files are kept unless overwriting is chosen: a number is put before the extension instead.
&mkvextract-gui; runs the &mkvmerge; and &mkvextract; installed next to it, else the ones found in the PATH.
